value.rationale: The natural residual-error constant κ is the exact datum in the 2026 motivating theorem. For the complete class of linear isometries the result converts the qualitative linear-rate guarantee into a globally exact worst-case contraction qκ, uniquely optimal constant parameters, sharp finite-horizon attainment, and a strict performance improvement over optimal single-evaluation Mann steps. The extremal spectral gap and rotation classes are mathematically canonical, not arbitrarily chosen finite indices; no downstream theorem is needed.
